text: いなかもんは　よわい　とか　おもった　だろ　ちきしょー

patterns.name: 〜とか
patterns.span: よわい　とか　おもった
patterns.explanation: とか before a thinking or saying verb quotes the thought loosely, like 'or something like that'. よわい　とか　おもった = 'thought they were weak or something'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end pushes the listener to agree; the short だろ is rough male speech. おもった　だろ = 'you thought so, didn't you'.
